# Review Scraper & Monitor

> Collect app, game, plugin or store reviews and detect which ones are new since the last run.

- Actor: data_foundry/review-scraper
- URL: https://apify.com/data_foundry/review-scraper
- Publisher: Data Foundry (https://apify.com/data_foundry)
- Category: Monitoring
- Pricing: $10 per 1,000 subjects scanned; pay per event, no subscription, failures not billed
- Input: app IDs, Play package names, Steam app IDs, plugin slugs, directory slugs
- Output: normalised reviews plus a per-subject signal with new and negative counts
- Run: apify call data_foundry/review-scraper
- API: POST https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/data_foundry~review-scraper/runs
- More actors: https://apify.com/data_foundry
